title: The Witnessed Difference Programme: From Finite Distinction to Witnessed Measurement
description:
This monograph studies finite report maps, protected questions and linear repair systems. A report preserves a question precisely when its answer is constant on each report fiber. The finite cochain framework distinguishes removable discrepancies, closed residual classes and failures of closure, with exact primal-dual certificates and explicit observation costs.

The 23 chapters develop finite algebraic constructions, conditional state/effect and process models, and separately stated model-specific analytic limits. Written proofs, selected Lean formalizations, executable checks and physical interpretation have different scopes. No derivation of quantum theory from primitive difference, universal cochain soundness theorem or demonstrated cochain search advantage is claimed.

Edition 2.4.0 derives exact fixed and adaptive recovery costs from explicit joint report supports. Finite cost witnesses exist for arbitrary supports; rational affine segments admit a constructive critical-value reduction checked through the existing finite solver. Shared-error and isolated-collision examples distinguish joint costs from marginal enclosures and incomplete sampling. The new proofs are written, not Lean formalizations. Physical realizability and further independent measurement error remain separate obligations.

Edition 2.4.1 is an editorial correction of 2.4.0: mathematical status, formalization scope and reproduction status are separated; the source and audit inventory is dated; the PDF includes its bibliography and proof-supplement locations.

Edition 2.4.3 carries nonnegative-weight, matching-norm and free empirical-table formation premises into the headline statements. It withdraws an unsupported global MUB6 classification while retaining the scoped parity and Tao-matrix results. Analytic supplements name their external inputs and distinguish general arguments from finite checks. A fresh selected Lean 4.34 compatibility replay is separate from historical pinned builds and does not establish a current complete pinned-package reproduction.

Edition 2.4.5 adds executable Lean certificate refinement and formal directed-reachability transport to the finite Horn reasoning calculus. Seventeen new declarations prove concrete proof/countermodel checking sound and preserve exact task/query binding. Python and Rust export closed kernel obligations; scoped replay evidence remains separate from universal foreign-language semantics, compiler trust, empirical adequacy and production deployment.
